content: Screaming Frog focuses on deep technical crawl (300+ issue types: broken links, crawl depth, redirects, canonicals) without prominent CMS/tech-stack display as a differentiator; Ahrefs and SEMrush combine crawling with broader platform features. None of the three surface CMS/tech-stack detection as a headline feature of their audit report UI per available sources (separate CMS-detector tools exist as standalone lookups, e.g. SE Ranking's free CMS Detector tool, suggesting this is treated as a lightweight utility/lead-gen feature rather than core audit output).
